newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Pepsi Philippines to consider foreign partner.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi Philippines to consider foreign partner.

text.p: Pepsi Cola Products Philippines Inc (PCPPI) is studying the possibility of taking in a foreign partner for its cola bottling operations in the country, a top company official said on Monday.

"We are studying various options to invite strategic foreign partners who have faith in the company's potential and the prospect of the Philippine economy in general," Luis P. Lorenzo Jr," PCPPI vice chairman said in a memorandum to employees.
Local firm Premier Beverage Co owns 51 percent of PCPPI while Pepsi Cola International holds the remaining 49 percent and owns the franchise.
The Lorenzo family owns 60 percent of Premier Beverage.
